# axm packs remove

Remove an extension from a pack manifest

## When to use

Remove an extension from a pack manifest

## Usage

```bash
axm packs remove [flags] <pack> <extension>
```

## Arguments

| Name        | Type   | Required | Description                    |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `pack`      | string | Yes      | Name of the pack               |
| `extension` | string | Yes      | Extension name or glob pattern |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                 |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Remove without confirmation                                 |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Remove even if it would leave the pack empty                |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would change in the manifest without modifying it |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Remove an extension from a pack**

```bash
axm packs remove frontend-tools @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Remove by pattern**

```bash
axm packs remove my-pack "@acme/effect-*"
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
